title: Tree of Life (Mithila Kalpavriksha)
description: An intricate Kachni monochrome line-work masterpiece depicting the eternal cosmic tree sheltering birds, fish, and mythical creatures of the Mithila wetlands.
story: In Mithila lore, the Kalpavriksha stands as the sacred axis connecting earth and heaven. Every leaf and petal is hand-hatched with bamboo nibs and natural kohl soot, symbolizing patience, ancestral fertility, and perpetual renewal.
medium: Fine Nib Ink & Natural Dyes on Raw Handmade Cotton Paper
interiorSuitability: Foyer Grandeur, Double-height Walls, Executive Boardroom

title: Surya Dev: The Radiant Sun God
description: Vibrant Bharni style painting drenched in radiant turmeric ochre, deep terracotta, and madder red celebrating the cosmic life-giver.
story: Surya is revered across Mithila as the source of vitality and truth. The concentric solar corona features lotus petals (*Kamal*) and eternal solar fish, bestowing warmth, courage, and prosperity to the dwelling.
medium: Natural Plant Pigments & Acrylic on Hand-stretched Canvas
interiorSuitability: East-facing Living Room, Home Temple / Pooja Sanctuary, Hallway Focus

title: Mithila Kohbar: The Nuptial Mandala
description: The sacred ceremonial Kohbar mural traditionally painted on the bridal chamber walls to bless the newly wedded couple with love and cosmic harmony.
story: Filled with esoteric symbols — the bamboo stalk (*bans*) representing lineage, lotus pond (*kamalban*) representing fertility, and twin parrots (*tota-maina*) symbolizing enduring romantic devotion.
medium: Mineral Colors, Gum Arabic, and Rice Powder on Textured Linen
interiorSuitability: Master Bedroom Headboard, Luxury Villa Living Pavilion

title: Mayur Yugala: The Twin Peacocks of Monsoon
description: A harmonious duet of royal peacocks entwined in flowering Kadamba branches, featuring rich peacock teal, vermilion, and mustard yellows.
story: Peacocks in Madhubani art embody romantic grace, monsoon celebration, and protective majesty. The ornate tail feathers are layered with signature Mithila geometric fills.
medium: Organic Dyes & Ink on Handmade Cow-dung Treated Paper (Traditional Gobar Leepan)
interiorSuitability: Dining Niche, Gallery Wall, Powder Room Accent

title: Godna Tattoo Mandala: Earth & Cosmic Rings
description: An authentic tribute to the ancient Godna tattooing tradition of Mithila using concentric circles, geometric sunbursts, and tribal rhythm.
story: Historically practiced by the Nat and Dusadh communities of Mithila, Godna uses repetitive concentric dots and needle-stroke motifs to represent planetary orbits and protective body talismans.
medium: Kohl Soot, Walnut Stain, and Indigo on Handmade Khadi Paper
interiorSuitability: Minimalist Japandi / Wabi-Sabi Interiors, Study, Reading Corner

title: Matsya Avatara: The Golden Fish of Prosperity
description: Exquisite fine-line Kachni painting featuring twin swimming fish surrounded by lotus blooms and water currents.
story: In Mithila culture, the fish (*Machhli*) is the supreme symbol of fertility, good omen, wealth, and liquid abundance. No festive wedding or harvest begins without this sacred motif.
medium: Black Ink Pen & Turmeric Wash on Vintage Handmade Paper
interiorSuitability: Entryway Console, Dining Credenza, Work Studio

title: Chitralekha Interior Panel: Ancient Mithila Meets Modern Sanctuary
description: Curated by Monika combining ancient geometric Mithila iconography with modern interior spatial acoustics and earthy architectural palettes.
story: Designed specifically for contemporary luxury homes. Designed and custom-scaled by Monika to bring positive Vastu energy, artisanal soul, and authentic Indian roots to modern interior architecture.
medium: Multi-layered Pigments, Gold Leaf Gilding & Acrylic on Archival Canvas
interiorSuitability: Living Room Feature Wall, Villa Lounge, Hospitality Suites

title: Shakti Yantra: Cosmic Tantrik Mandala
description: Esoteric Tantrik Madhubani depiction of divine feminine energy featuring geometric triangles, lotus circles, and consecrated primary pigments.
story: Rooted in the ancient Tantric tradition of Mithila, this sacred geometric mandala is meditated upon for focus, spiritual elevation, and divine balance in the home.
medium: Vermilion (Sindoor), Natural Charcoal & Indigo on Hand-pressed Paper
interiorSuitability: Meditation Room, Wellness Studio, Private Library
